title: Video Display Interface
text: Simulate display of images to video screen on device, 1 input, 1 output, {Image size} sets Image size; {Output}, {Image size ([width, height])} sets the image size, {Pixel format} sets the format of the pixel and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output
params.values: Output type To terminator (default) | To output port

params.name: Image size ([width, height])
params.values: Image size [320, 240] (default) | two-element vector of positive integers

params.name: Pixel format
params.values: Format of the pixel data RGB (default) | YCbCr 4:2:2

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time in seconds -1 (default) | positive scalar
